paragraphs.en: Dorothy rushed into the Scarecrow's embrace, his painted face beaming with delight as he held her close. The Tin Woodman gently hugged her, careful not to squeeze too hard. Dorothy then gave Tiktok’s key to the Scarecrow and wound up the machine man so he could properly bow when introduced.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西扑进了稻草人的怀抱，他的彩绘脸上洋溢着喜悦，紧紧地抱着她。铁皮人温柔地拥抱着她，小心翼翼地没有用力过猛。接着，多萝西把钛托的钥匙交给了稻草人，并给机械人上满了发条，好让他在被介绍时能正式地鞠躬致意。

paragraphs.en: She told them how useful Tiktok had been, and both the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman thanked him for protecting their friend.
paragraphs.zh: 她告诉他们TikTok有多么有用，两位朋友——稻草人和铁皮人——也感激他保护了他们的伙伴。

paragraphs.en: "Where is Billina?" Dorothy asked anxiously.
paragraphs.zh: “比琳娜在哪里？”多萝西焦急地问道。

paragraphs.en: The Scarecrow admitted he didn't know who she was. The Princess informed Dorothy that Billina, a yellow hen, was in the chicken house in the backyard. "My drawing-room is no place for hens," she added.
paragraphs.zh: 稻草人承认他不认识她。公主告诉多萝西，在后院的鸡舍里有一只黄色母鸡，名叫比林娜。“我的客厅可没有母鸡的位置。”她补充道。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy ran to find Billina and encountered the Cowardly Lion outside, still hitched to the chariot beside the great Tiger. The Lion wore a blue ribbon bow, while the Tiger had a red one on his tail. Dorothy hugged the Lion joyfully.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西跑去找比林娜，不巧在外边遇到了仍旧被绑在大虎旁边战车上的胆小狮。狮子系着一条蓝色的丝带，而老虎则在尾巴上挂着一条红色的丝带。多萝西欣喜地拥抱了胆小狮。

paragraphs.en: "I'm SO glad to see you again!" she exclaimed.
paragraphs.zh: “真是太高兴再次见到你了！”她脱口而出。

paragraphs.en: The Lion replied, "I am also glad to see you, Dorothy. We've had some fine adventures together, haven't we?"
paragraphs.zh: 狮子回答说：“也很高兴见到你，多萝西。我们共同经历了一些精彩冒险，不是吗？”

paragraphs.en: "Yes, indeed," she said. "How are you?"
paragraphs.zh: “是的，确实如此，”她说道，“你怎么样？”

paragraphs.en: "As cowardly as ever," he meekly answered. "But let me introduce my new friend, the Hungry Tiger."
paragraphs.zh: “和往常一样胆小呢，”他谦卑地回答道，“不过让我给大家介绍一下我的新朋友——贪食虎。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy turned to the Tiger, who was yawning widely, revealing two rows of terrible teeth and a big mouth. The Tiger admitted, "Dreadfully hungry." When asked why he didn't eat something, he sadly replied, "I've tried that, but I always get hungry again."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西转向那只正在打哈欠的老虎，只见它张开大嘴，露出了两排可怕的牙齿。老虎承认道：“饿得要命。”当被问及为什么不吃点东西时，他悲伤地回答说：“我试过了，但总是很快就又饿了。”

paragraphs.en: "Then why don't you eat something?" Dorothy asked.
paragraphs.zh: “那你为什么不吃点东西呢？”多萝西问道。

paragraphs.en: The Tiger explained, "It's no use. For my part, I'm a savage beast with an appetite for all sorts of poor little living creatures, from chipmunks to fat babies."
paragraphs.zh: 老虎解释说：“没用了。就我而言，我是一头野兽，对各种可怜的小生灵都有胃口，从松鼠到胖乎乎的婴儿。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy exclaimed, "How dreadful!"
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西惊叫道：“太可怕了！”

paragraphs.en: The Hungry Tiger licked his lips with his long red tongue. "Fat babies! Don't they sound delicious?"
paragraphs.zh: 饥饿的老虎用他那长而红的舌头舔了舔嘴唇，“肥嘟嘟的小宝贝们！听起来多美味啊！”

paragraphs.en: He added, "But I've never eaten any because my conscience tells me it's wrong."
paragraphs.zh: 他补充道：“但我从未吃过任何野味，因为我的良知告诉我这样做是不对的。”

paragraphs.en: "I think you are a very good tiger," said Dorothy, patting the beast’s huge head.
paragraphs.zh: “我觉得你是一只很好的老虎。”多萝西拍了拍那头大猫的脑袋，说道。

paragraphs.en: "You're mistaken," replied the Tiger. "I am a good beast, but a disgracefully bad tiger. Tigers should be cruel and ferocious, yet I refuse to eat harmless creatures.
paragraphs.zh: “你搞错了，”老虎回答，“我确实是一只不错的野兽，但是一只好不到哪里去的老虎。老虎应该残忍凶猛，但我宁可不吃那些无害的生灵。”

paragraphs.en: That's why I left the forest for my friend the Cowardly Lion."
paragraphs.zh: 这就是我离开森林去找胆小狮的原因。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy disagreed, saying, "The Lion is not really cowardly; he acts bravely." The Lion corrected her, "I may have seemed brave at times, but I was always afraid."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西不同意，说：“狮子并不是真的胆小，他表现得很勇敢。”狮子纠正她说：“我可能有时显得很勇敢，但实际上我一直都很害怕。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy truthfully added, "Nor am I. But I must set Billina free and see you again later."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西诚实地说道：“我也没闲着。但我必须先释放比林娜，然后再来找你。”

paragraphs.en: She ran to the palace’s back yard and found the chicken house by the loud cackling and crowing. Inside, hens and roosters were huddled in one corner, watching a whirling ball of feathers. The chickens’ screeching nearly deafened her.
paragraphs.zh: 她跑到宫殿的后院，听到鸡鸣声和咯咯叫声，找到了鸡舍。里面，母鸡和公鸡挤在角落里，注视着一只旋转的羽毛球。鸡群的尖叫几乎让她耳鸣。

paragraphs.en: Suddenly, the feathers stopped spinning, revealing Billina on top of a speckled rooster. They remained motionless for an instant before Billina shook her wings and strutted out with a victorious cluck. The rooster limped away, trailing his damaged plumage in the dust.
paragraphs.zh: 突然，羽毛停止了旋转，露出了比琳娜站在一只花色公鸡的背上。他们一动不动地停顿了一下，随后比琳娜抖了抖翅膀，得意洋洋地走了出来，并发出了一阵胜利的咯咯声。那只公鸡一瘸一拐地走开了，拖着破损的羽毛在尘土中摇摇晃晃。

paragraphs.en: "Why, Billina!" Dorothy cried, shocked; "have you been fighting?"
paragraphs.zh: “比琳娜，你怎么了！”多萝西惊讶地喊道，“你刚才在打架吗？”

paragraphs.en: Billina retorted, "I really think I have." Dorothy replied, "Do you think I'd let that speckled rooster lord it over me and claim to run this chicken house? Not if my name is Bill!"
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜反驳道：“我确实认为我会这么做。”多萝西回答说，“你真的以为那只花斑公鸡会趾高气扬地主宰这里，声称要管理这家禽院吗？别做梦了，我的名字可是比琳娜！”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy corrected, "It's Billina, and you're talking slang."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西纠正道：“是比琳娜，你在说俚语。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy unlocked the door for Billina. The yellow hen emerged while other chickens watched silently from their corner. Dorothy lifted her friend, exclaiming, "Oh, Billina!
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西为比琳娜开了门。那只黄色的母鸡走了出来，而其他鸡则默默地看着它们，躲在一旁。多萝西抱起她的朋友，脱口而出：“哦，比琳娜！”

paragraphs.en: How dreadful you look. You've lost many feathers, one eye is nearly pecked out, and your comb is bleeding!"
paragraphs.zh: 你看起来真吓人。你好像掉了很多羽毛，一只眼睛快被啄瞎了，冠上还流血了！

paragraphs.en: Billina replied, "That's nothing. Just look at the speckled rooster! Didn't I do him up brown?"
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜回答说：“这算什么？你看那只花色公鸡！我不是已经把他收拾得服服帖帖了吗？”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy shook her head, saying, "I don't approve of this. It isn't a good thing for you to associate with those common chickens." She carried Billina toward the palace.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西摇了摇头，说道：“我不赞成这个。和那些普通的鸡混在一起对你没有好处。”她带着比琳娜向宫殿走去。

paragraphs.en: Billina responded, "I didn't ask to associate with them. The Princess is to blame. But I was raised in the United States and won't allow any chicken from Ev to run over me."
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜回答说：“我可没求着和他们混在一起。公主该负责任。不过，我是在美国长大的，不会让来自厄维的鸡飞到我的头上。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy said, "Very well, Billina. We won't talk about it anymore." They approached the Cowardly Lion and Hungry Tiger.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西说：“好吧，比琳娜。我们不要再提这件事了。”她们走近胆小的狮子和贪吃虎。

paragraphs.en: The Lion greeted Billina politely, "Glad to meet any friend of Dorothy's," noting her appearance. The Tiger looked at Billina greedily, saying, "Your present appearance makes my mouth water. How good you would taste if I could crunch you between my jaws."
paragraphs.zh: 狮子礼貌地向比琳娜打招呼：“见到多萝西的朋友很高兴。”他一边说一边打量着比琳娜。老虎则贪婪地看着比琳娜，说道：“你现在的样子让我垂涎三尺，如果我能用我的牙齿咬碎你，那该有多美味啊。”

paragraphs.en: Billina nestled closer in Dorothy's arms and said, "Besides, it wouldn't be right." The Tiger continued, "Of course not. Billina is your friend, and you mustn't eat her under any circumstances."
paragraphs.zh: 比琳娜靠得更近，对多萝西说：“再说，这样做也不对。”老虎接着说道：“当然不行。比琳娜是你的朋友，你绝不能吃她。”

paragraphs.en: Dorothy quickly added, "I'll try to remember that; but I'm a little absent-minded at times."
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西急忙补充道：“我会尽量记住的；不过我有时确实有点心不在焉。”

paragraphs.en: Tiktok sat between the Scarecrow and the Tin Woodman. Opposite them were Ozma and Princess Langwidere, with an empty chair for Dorothy.
paragraphs.zh: 铁皮人和稻草人都坐在提克托克钟之间，对面则是奥兹玛和朗吉德瑞公主，中间空着一把椅子留给多萝西。

paragraphs.en: Surrounding this group was the Army of Oz. Dorothy noted the handsome uniforms of the Twenty-Seven soldiers. The Tin Woodman explained that his army consisted of eight Generals, six Colonels, seven Majors, five Captains, and one private.
paragraphs.zh: 围绕着这支队伍的是奥兹国的军队。多萝西注意到这二十七名士兵英俊的军装。铁皮人解释说，他的军队由八位将军、六位上校、七位中校、五位少校和一名普通士兵组成。

paragraphs.en: He wanted to promote the private, believing officers were more reliable and important.
paragraphs.zh: 他希望推广这种观念，认为私人军官更为可靠且重要。

paragraphs.en: Dorothy agreed with him as she sat beside Ozma. Ozma then declared they would hold a conference to decide how to free the royal family of Ev from their long imprisonment.
paragraphs.zh: 多萝西坐在奥兹玛身旁，赞同地点了点头。随后，奥兹玛宣布她们将召开一次会议，商讨如何解救艾夫王国的王室成员，让他们摆脱长久的囚禁。
